We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts. The case: Zhang1 fraud by signing contracts, false representation, obtaining money from victims. This is classic fraud (诈骗). The correction lessons mention "票据诈骗;信用卡诈骗;合同诈骗" as specific types. Here the fraud is via false contracts, i.e., contract fraud. The label should be "合同诈骗". In correction lessons, they say: "Correct label 【票据诈骗;信用卡诈骗;合同诈骗】 (not 「[罪名]诈骗<eoa>」): 关键在于案情中明确涉及票据、信用卡和合同等具体诈骗手段，应分别标注为票据诈骗、信用卡诈骗、合同诈骗，而不是笼统的‘诈骗’。" So we should use "合同诈骗". No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>.
